findings.reason: Step 1.2 uses the tensor-power map H^{⊗n} on elementary tensors, but def-qc-tensor-register-and-permutation defines tensor spaces and inner products, not tensor maps. Add def-qc-tensor-map as a prerequisite or define and justify this action locally.

Uniqueness step 4.1 differentiates t ↦ exp(iλ_j t), but F8 supplies the complex derivative of exp without a chain-rule result; it also applies F9's mean value theorem without establishing continuity of the real and imaginary parts of g_jk. Derive the scalar derivative from F6 and F8 by a difference quotient, and supply or derive differentiability-implies-continuity for the MVT application.

The Definition treats U_H(t)ψ as a pure-state ray, which requires U_H(t)ψ to be nonzero. Its dependencies do not include the matrix-evolution unitarity result that establishes norm preservation. Add thm-qa-19-matrix-exponential-unitary-properties as a prerequisite.

Step 1.1 and F3 use attainment of the operator-norm maximum to bound ||(W−U)ψ||. The cited definition says the maximum's existence is proved by thm-operator-norm-is-the-largest-singular-value, but that theorem is absent from this lemma's dependencies. Add it as a prerequisite.

The Definition constructs X_j as an operator acting on one tensor factor and as identity on the others, and requests local U_{X_j} operations. These tensor maps require def-qc-tensor-map, which is absent from the dependencies.

Steps 2.1–3.1 use tensor products of operators, including ⊗_j U_X(t) and X^{⊗n}; the current tensor-register supplier defines spaces and vector bases but not these maps. Add def-qc-tensor-map as a prerequisite.

The Statement asserts n one-qubit evolution calls for every hypercube run, but the algorithm permits a whole-operation branch that applies U_{A_n}(π/2) once. The factorization theorem proves an operator identity, not an operation count. Make the n-call and primitive-gate count conditional on the local-operation branch; account for the whole-operation branch using its declared contract.
Verification steps 1.1 and 2.1 use tensor-product operators such as X⊗I, I⊗X, and U_X⊗U_X, but the dependencies do not include the tensor-map definition. Add def-qc-tensor-map as a prerequisite.
